profile: I work in risk development, combining credit-risk modeling with portfolio analysis and reporting automation. I prepare and validate data, compare model results, and turn lending policies into decision rules. I also work with business and IT teams to investigate issues and document the checks behind the results.

skills.label: Data & reporting
skills.items: Python, SQL, pandas, Polars, DuckDB, Parquet, Excel/VBA, BigQuery

skills.label: Risk & modeling
skills.items: Credit scoring, feature engineering, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM, XGBoost, Optuna

skills.label: Evaluation
skills.items: AUC, Gini, KS, threshold analysis, temporal validation, leakage checks, risk segmentation, performance monitoring

skills.label: Automation & delivery
skills.items: GoRules/Zen, FastAPI, reconciliation, reproducible data workflows, n8n, RapidMiner Studio

experience: Prepare and validate credit and portfolio data for risk analysis, recurring reports, and decision-strategy reviews.
Develop and evaluate credit-scoring models, checking feature availability, generalization, and risk segmentation; document inputs for technical handoff.
Build portfolio-risk reporting workflows with Polars, Parquet, DuckDB, and Excel/VBA, retaining identifier and mapping traceability.
Design and test Credit Decision Engine rules, produce monthly scoring and CDE performance reports, and investigate production issues with business and IT teams.
Develop a repeat-order propensity workflow with agreement-level lineage, temporal validation, and leakage checks. This work remains in development.
